Please confirm

  • Q1 (user: B) applied: the shell's PIN redirect writes UBTConnect.LastURL = the opened path (CR-PINUnlock-1 applied), so after unlock the screen goes to the resume link, else UBTConnect.LastURL, else HomeFeed (the HomeFeed fallback for an empty LastURL is not in the original code). Example: Profile → PINUnlock → Profile.
  • Q2 (user: A) applied: Block_PINUnlock composed in the screen from the shared Layout_LoginFlow, ContentWrapper and CommonUI_InsideLayout until CR-PINUnlock-2 lands; the unsupported-system card is not built (as in the shell, U16).
  • Q3 (user: A) applied: parity exemptions reused (CAPTURE-SVG-PRESERVEASPECTRATIO, CAPTURE-LOGO-REPLAY, CAPTURE-LOADING-BODYCLASS, CAPTURE-LOADING-TRANSITION) and two added for the PIN keypad (CAPTURE-LOGO-REPLAY-PINCODE: header sizes/offsets after the broken logo; CAPTURE-LINK-HREF-CURSOR-PINCODE: Forgot PIN and policy links) [migration/parity-exemptions.json]. Masked keypad digits need no entry (parity masks them).
  • ScreenController_NavigateToPage(URL, True) is a replace navigation inside the SPA (knowledge/shell-facts.md:39); a full URL in LastURL (Splash stores the href) is reduced to its path + search.
  • Policy links and Forgot PIN behave as the shared ContentWrapper (policy links do nothing yet; shared README).
